title: The upload surface renders a labelled file input, a drop-zone region and a keyboard-focusable alternative that opens the picker on Enter
asA: operator selecting files to upload, whether by pointer, drag-drop or keyboard alone
iWant: a labelled native file input, a drop-zone region and a keyboard-focusable button that opens the picker so I can add files from whichever input mode I use
soThat: I never have to drag to add a file and my screen reader announces the picker rather than a silent drop-zone

acceptanceCriteria.description: The upload region carries [data-surface="file-upload"] and inside it: a labelled <input type="file"> with a keyboard-reachable label (an id-referenced <label> or an aria-label), a [data-drop-zone] region, and a keyboard-focusable [data-open-picker] button that opens the same picker on Enter or Space. The pack drives the real browser to /upload, asserts the three affordances are present, focuses the [data-open-picker] control and presses Enter, then reads that the file input received focus.

A file whose MIME type is outside the elicited accepted-set is refused at the input with an inline error naming the mismatch and the accepted set; no request is sent to the transport. Applying agent sets: accepted-set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a file whose MIME type is outside the accepted-set
acceptanceCriteria.when: the principal drops or selects the file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the input refuses the file inline, an aria-describedby-bound error names the mismatch and the accepted set, and no transport call fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: A file whose size exceeds the elicited size-cap is refused inline with the cap named in bytes and a human-readable form; the input never accepts the file into the drop-zone queue. Applying agent sets: size-cap.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a file whose size exceeds the elicited size-cap
acceptanceCriteria.when: the principal drops or selects the file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the input refuses inline with the cap named and no transport call fires
